javascript.details: bind and getPort return -1, send returns false, and callback registration or close becomes a no-op for missing context or rejected input. Wrapper error text is not exported; receive callback exceptions are not surfaced by this binding.

lua.details: luaL checks raise Lua errors for invalid required arguments; bind and getPort return -1, send returns false, and callback registration or close becomes a no-op for unavailable context or rejected handles. Wrapper error text is not exported.

wasmtime.details: Host calls do not trap. bind and getPort return -1 when unavailable or on wrapper failure; send returns 0; recv returns bytes received, 0 for no datagram or invalid bridge state, -1 on wrapper error, and -2 when the guest buffer is too small; close becomes a no-op.

capability_relationships.unavailable_behavior: Browser builds report capability false and register neither sys.net.udp for managed JavaScript/Lua nor env.udp_* imports for browser-native WebAssembly.

browser_wasm.reason: The browser-native WebAssembly env object registers no udp_* imports and browser builds provide no raw datagram backend.

details: The web managed-runtime initialization registers no sys.net.udp namespace.
The browser-native WebAssembly env object registers no udp_* imports.

operations.name: bind
operations.signature: (local_port: i32; 0 requests auto-assignment) -> i32 socket_handle; -1 on failure

operations.name: send
operations.signature: (socket_handle: i32, host: string, port: i32, data: bytes) -> bool

javascript.name: send
javascript.signature: (socket_handle: number, host: string, port: number, data: array-like bytes) -> bool

lua.name: send
lua.signature: (socket_handle: integer, host: string, port: integer, data: byte[]) -> bool

wasmtime.name: udp_send
wasmtime.signature: (socket_handle: i32, host_ptr: i32, host_len: i32, port: i32, data_ptr: i32, data_len: i32) -> i32 bool

operations.name: receive
operations.signature: receive datagrams with sender host and port

javascript.name: onMessage
javascript.signature: (socket_handle: number, callback: ({data: number[], host: string, port: number}) -> void) -> void; nullish or non-function callback clears registration

lua.name: onMessage
lua.signature: (socket_handle: integer, callback: function|nil) -> nil; nil or non-function callback clears registration

wasmtime.name: udp_recv
wasmtime.signature: (socket_handle: i32, data_ptr: i32, data_capacity: i32, info_ptr: i32) -> i32; writes port i32 plus a 64-byte NUL-terminated host field at info_ptr
